notes.title: [Important Notice]Solution for Gtarcade Desktop Game Crashing Issues
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We have received feedback regarding the game crashing issues on the Gtarcade Desktop. After our latest investigation, we have determined that some crashing issues are due to problems with the graphics card drivers on players' computers, which prevent the proper release of underlying rendering resources.

To address this issue, we recommend updating your graphics card driver to version 560.38 through the following link:

[url=https://developer.nvidia.com/downloads/assets/geforce-drivers/560.38_gameready_win11_win10-dch_64bit_international.exe]Download Link[/url]



We are still investigating other causes of the crashes. Please be patient as we work to provide further solutions.

Thank you for your understanding and support!

 

Best regards,

Gtarcade Team
